question: In a common rail diesel fuel injection system, what is the primary function of the pressure accumulator (rail)?
options: To filter fuel before delivery to injectors
To maintain a constant high fuel pressure regardless of engine demand
To regulate the return fuel temperature
To prime the low-pressure fuel circuit

question: When diagnosing an engine that exhibits excessive blue-grey smoke under acceleration, which combination of faults is MOST likely responsible?
options: Worn valve stem seals and worn piston rings
Blocked EGR valve and restricted air filter
Rich fuel mixture and faulty lambda sensor
Sticking thermostat and coolant loss

question: A vehicle fitted with a continuously variable transmission (CVT) uses a steel push-belt running between two variable-diameter pulleys. What controls the effective pulley diameter ratio?
options: Hydraulic pressure acting on movable pulley flanges
Electromagnetic clutch engagement frequency
Mechanical governor flyweights
Electronic throttle position only

question: In an anti-lock braking system (ABS), what is the sequence of solenoid valve operations during a wheel lock-up event?
options: Hold, decrease, increase pressure
Increase, hold, decrease pressure
Decrease, increase, hold pressure
Hold, increase, decrease pressure

question: A four-cylinder four-stroke engine has a bore of 82 mm and a stroke of 90 mm. What is the total engine displacement in cubic centimetres (to the nearest cc)?
Which sensor in a modern petrol engine management system is responsible for detecting abnormal combustion (detonation) and retarding ignition timing accordingly?
options: Crankshaft position sensor
Knock sensor
Manifold absolute pressure sensor
Throttle position sensor

question: In a MacPherson strut suspension system, what geometric change occurs to camber angle when the wheel moves through full jounce?
options: Camber becomes increasingly negative
Camber becomes increasingly positive
Camber remains constant due to fixed geometry
Camber alternates between positive and negative

question: What is the purpose of the torque converter's stator (reactor) element in an automatic transmission?
options: To multiply input torque during acceleration by redirecting fluid flow
To engage the lock-up clutch at cruising speed
To cool the transmission fluid during high load conditions
To provide reverse gear engagement

question: A technician measures 0.8 volts on a wideband lambda (oxygen) sensor at idle with the engine fully warm. What does this indicate about the air-fuel ratio?
options: The mixture is rich (lambda less than 1)
The mixture is lean (lambda greater than 1)
The mixture is stoichiometric
The sensor has failed open circuit

question: In a vehicle equipped with electronic stability control (ESC), which additional sensor is required compared to a basic ABS system?
options: Yaw rate sensor and lateral acceleration sensor
Longitudinal acceleration sensor only
Steering angle sensor only
Wheel speed sensors on front axle only

question: Which type of bearing is MOST commonly used for the main crankshaft journals in modern automotive engines and why?
options: Plain shell bearings, because they offer a large load-bearing surface and hydrodynamic lubrication
Ball bearings, because they reduce rotational friction at high RPM
Tapered roller bearings, because they handle both radial and axial loads
Needle roller bearings, because they require minimal lubrication

question: During a compression test on a petrol engine, cylinders 2 and 3 show equally low readings, but adding oil through the spark plug holes does not improve the readings. What is the MOST probable cause?
options: A blown head gasket between cylinders 2 and 3
Worn piston rings on cylinders 2 and 3
Worn cylinder bores on cylinders 2 and 3
Sticking intake valves on cylinders 2 and 3

question: In a hydraulic power steering system, what is the function of the rotary (torsion bar) control valve?
options: To direct pressurised fluid to either side of the rack piston based on steering input torque
To regulate maximum system pressure via a relief valve only
To disengage the pump during straight-line driving
To provide variable ratio steering geometry

question: A vehicle's alternator output voltage is measured at 12.2 V at 2000 rpm with all accessories on. What fault does this MOST likely indicate?
options: A faulty voltage regulator not allowing the alternator to charge fully
A normal condition at moderate engine speed
An overcharging condition requiring battery replacement
An open circuit in the starter motor circuit

question: In a dual-clutch transmission (DCT), what is the primary advantage of having two separate clutches operating on odd and even gear sets?
options: Gear changes can be pre-selected, allowing near-instantaneous shifts with no torque interruption
The transmission can operate without any clutch synchronisation
Reverse gear is engaged through the primary clutch only
The system eliminates the need for a differential entirely
